nodes.description: Private core transfer routine that validates blacklist/maxTx, computes contract token balance and triggers swapAndLiquify before executing the token transfer.
Private dispatcher that applies/removes fees and routes to the excluded/standard transfer variants.
Private lockTheSwap function that splits contract tokens, swaps for ETH, adds liquidity and forwards ETH to marketing.
Private function approving the router and swapping tokens for ETH via the Uniswap router.
Private function approving tokens and calling addLiquidityETH on the Uniswap router.
Private function forwarding ETH to the marketing wallet address.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards msg.sender and recipient to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that executes _transfer and reduces the caller allowance.
Owner-only function that sweeps the contract ETH balance to the marketing wallet.
Owner-only function approving and transferring tokens held by the contract to the owner.
Owner-only function inserting an address into the blacklist arrays/mapping.
Private function crediting the marketing/liquidity fee to the contract's reflection and token balances.
Private view computing reflected and token supply excluding excluded accounts for the rate calculation.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, owner and allowance owner across the token flows.
Origin address checked against the blacklist inside _transfer (phishing/tx.origin dependency risk).
Miner-influenced deadline passed to Uniswap swap and liquidity calls.
ETH transfer to the marketing wallet address, which can revert and is executed after external swap calls.
External router call performing a token swap and transferring ETH; reachable mid-transfer for reentrancy.
External router call adding liquidity with ETH value, executing arbitrary pair logic.
Mapping of reflected token balances per address.
Mapping of raw token balances for excluded accounts.
Mapping of ERC20 allowances between owner and spender.
Mapping flagging blacklisted addresses blocked from transferring.
Mapping flagging accounts exempt from transfer fees.
Mapping flagging accounts excluded from reflection rewards.
Maximum transfer amount enforced in _transfer.
Reentrancy lock flag set during swapAndLiquify.
Reflection tax fee percentage used to compute transfer fees.
Total reflections used to derive the reflection rate.
From address parameter of _transfer and other internal transfer helpers.
To address parameter of _transfer and other internal transfer helpers.
Token amount parameter of _transfer and the public ERC20 entry points.
Local boolean deciding whether fees are applied, passed from _transfer to _tokenTransfer.
Local amount of tokens held by the contract and queued for swap and liquidity.
Amount of tokens approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
Local half of the liquidity token amount used to size the ETH swap.
Local portion of contract tokens reserved for the marketing wallet.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender address of the transfer flow in _transfer.
tx.origin is read inside _transfer for the blacklist check, creating a tx.origin dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in addLiquidity.
transfer invokes _transfer for the token movement.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender when reducing the allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
transfer uses msg.sender as the origin of the token movement.
_transfer delegates the final balance updates to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify, which performs external Uniswap calls before the transfer state updates complete.
_transfer checks _isBlackListedBot for sender and recipient.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount on the transfer amount.
_transfer reads the inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy lock flag.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take a fee.
_transfer indirectly reads _rOwned through balanceOf for the contract token balance.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity to pair the remaining tokens with ETH.
swapAndLiquify forwards the remaining swapped ETH to the marketing wallet.
swapAndLiquify runs under the lockTheSwap modifier writing inSwapAndLiquify.
swapTokensForEth performs an external Uniswap router swap that transfers control to the router/pair.
addLiquidity makes an external addLiquidityETH call with ETH value, handing control to the router/pair.
sendETHToMarketing pushes ETH to the marketing wallet address, transferring control/value externally.
_tokenTransfer routes the marketing/liquidity fee to _takeMarketingLiquidity.
_takeMarketingLiquidity multiplies fee amounts by the reflection rate and credits _rOwned.
_takeMarketingLiquidity adds the fee to _tOwned when the contract is excluded.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _rTotal when computing the reflected supply.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded _tOwned balances from the token supply, an arithmetic-sensitive loop.
manualSend forwards the contract ETH balance through sendETHToMarketing.
manualSend is gated by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender to _owner.
recoverTokens transfers contract-held tokens back to the owner via _transfer.
addBotToBlackList is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
addBotToBlackList writes the blacklist mapping _isBlackListedBot for the supplied account.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only a parameter name for the from-address already represented by the _transfer core function semantics.
recipient is only a parameter name for the to-address of the _transfer core function.
amount is the token quantity handled directly by the _transfer core function.
takeFee is a local decision flag consumed by _tokenTransfer to apply or remove fees.
contractTokenBalance is the local amount passed into swapAndLiquify for swapping and liquidity.
tokenAmount is the swap amount parameter belonging to the swapTokensForEth core function.
half is a local split of the liquidity amount computed inside swapAndLiquify.
toMarketing is a local fee split computed inside swapAndLiquify.
